description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and device configuration functions primarily for TP-Link devices. It includes functions to modify flash layout parameters, perform image checks, and execute the upgrade process depending on device type.

methods.name: tplink_sg2xxx_fix_mtdparts
methods.description: Configures MTD partition layout and serial baud rate for specific TP-Link devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs a check on the device image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for different TP-Link hardware models based on the board name.
